features.title: Exit Window: measure how long a copier has after a Hyperliquid wallet starts exiting, backtest copying it at your latency, follow it live and mirror its reduces

product_gate.user: Retail perp traders who copy Hyperliquid whales, e.g. @0x_rckfrd, @Dan4thepump1, @Doepie669
product_gate.buyer: Individual copy traders; secondary: copy-trade vault operators choosing whom to follow
product_gate.job: Decide whether a wallet is copyable at my latency, and get out when it gets out
product_gate.verb: follow a wallet and mirror its reduces (paper by default, Hyperliquid order via Nansen perp trading when keyed)
product_gate.wedge: Per-wallet exit window measured from Nansen perp-trades plus copier-latency backtest (0s/1m/5m/15m/60m)
product_gate.direct_alternative: Copin Single Backtesting (copin.io): backtests copying a Hyperliquid trader with capital/leverage/SL, but no copier latency or slippage model and no Nansen labels; Copin copy trade mirrors decreases
product_gate.new_capability: Before following: what copying this wallet returned at YOUR delay, and median minutes between its first reduce and the adverse move. While following: reduce alert stating the measured window left
product_gate.kill_shot: If Copin or Nansen already shows latency-adjusted copy PnL and exit windows, this is a feature not a product; copy bots that mirror closes instantly shrink the pain to slippage
